valueNote: The piece gives a dated career timeline from the Haas primary profile (Super Formula, Super GT, ELMS, junior titles, WEC results) that the press call-up reports do not. Sections are named for their content and the article avoids hype words. Frontmatter and body agree. Minor wording only: 'Rest des Grand Prix' versus source 'remainder of the weekend' is equivalent. racer-ocon-replacement-2026 returned HTTP 429 on two attempts and is not cited anywhere in the article, so it does not affect any verdict.
summary: All cited facts check out against the Haas profile, the F1 articles (Ocon replacement, dream-come-true, 2025 reserve-driver) and RaceFans. Quotes are accurate translations of the source wording. No uncited factual claims. racer-ocon-replacement-2026 was unreachable (HTTP 429, twice) and is not cited by the article. Decision: approve.
